title: Endpoint latency atlas: per-route x model x region p95/p99 explorer and automated regression gate
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver an "endpoint latency atlas"—an interactive explorer and SLO tiles that surface p95 and p99 latency by route, model, and region, plus an automated regression gate that can block rollouts when percentile regressions exceed thresholds. This ticket covers instrumentation, aggregation, dashboard surface, alert gating, and bench integration.

Background and motivation:
- We need per-dimension (route, model, region) high-fidelity percentile tracking to diagnose regressions introduced by runtime/kernel changes, batching behavior, or model variants. Existing rollups are too coarse for targeted investigations.
- Product/infra teams want an actionable UI and machine-checkable gate for canary/rollout pipelines.

Scope and non-goals:
- In-scope: Emit and store p50/p90/p95/p99 slices at 10s resolution, compute daily and hourly rollups, interactive UI with heat-map, SLO tiles, and a regression detector that compares current window to baseline. Integrate with Loadsmith v2 harness for automated runs.
- Out-of-scope: End-to-end rollout automation in CI; that will be a follow-up once detection thresholds are stable.

Instrumentation plan:
1) Client-side: Extend runtime telemetry to attach route and model tags (route path, model id, region, batch-size, seq-length-bucket). Ensure token accounting is included for tokens/sec correlation.
2) Aggregation: Emit quantile histograms to percentile-store (existing TSDB ingest path) with 10s buckets and a retention policy compatible with console queries (30d hot, 365d cold).
3) Bench integration: Loadsmith v2 will run representative traffic shapes (small-chat, long-context, code-complete) across region-model combinations and write annotated runs into the atlas.

Dashboard / UX surface:
- Heat-map view: rows=routes, cols=models, tiles per-region toggle. Each tile shows p95/p99 numbers, sparkline over 24h, and a tokens/sec overlay. Clicking tile drills to time-series and raw sample traces.
- SLO tiles: configurable SLO threshold per route/model/region (example: p95 < 300ms). SLO color states (OK/Warn/Fail).
- Diff mode: compare baseline window (last successful canary) to current to show percent delta for p95/p99 and tokens/sec.

Regression gate rules (proposal):
- Hard block: p99 increases by >40% AND absolute p99 > 600ms OR p95 increases by >25% AND absolute p95 > 400ms.
- Soft warn: p95 increase >=15% OR p99 increase >=20% (creates pager+ticket but doesn't block).
- Require at least 100 sample requests in the comparison window to avoid noisy signals.

Acceptance criteria, observability and testing:
- Telemetry emits route+model+region tagged percentile histograms at 10s resolution (verify with sample ingest).
- Atlas UI shows heat-map and drill-through for at least two representative routes (/v1/chat, /v1/embeddings) across three models and 2 regions.
- Loadsmith v2 integration: automated benchmark job that can populate atlas with synthetic runs; baseline and current comparison available.
- Regression gate implemented as a service that exposes an API for the rollout pipeline; defined thresholds fire correctly on synthetic regressions.
- Unit + integration tests for percentile ingestion, rollups, and gate logic.
- Dashboard links and runbook added to Confluence and Console.

Data retention and cost considerations:
- 10s resolution hot retention for 30d; aggregate hourly rollups beyond 30d and daily rollups to 1y.
- Estimate: +5-8% TSDB ingest for percentile payloads, additional Console storage for heat-map tiles. We'll instrument cost and add a quota if needed.

Rollout plan:
1) Instrumentation and backend ingest (canary with a single route/model/region).
2) Bench integration and populate atlas with multi-shape runs.
3) UX and SLO tile work.
4) Enable regression gate behind feature flag; run several internal canary rollouts with automatic detection disabled (monitor-only).
5) Flip soft warnings on, monitor for false positives for 2 weeks.
6) Enable hard blocks for a subset of non-critical rollouts before broader enablement.

- Load harness jobs: https://github.com/redwood/loadsmith/actions (jobs/use-atlas)

acceptance_criteria: Percentile histograms are emitted with route, model, region tags at 10s resolution and visible in TSDB ingest logs.
Atlas heat-map shows p95 and p99 for /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings across at least 3 models and 2 regions.
Loadsmith v2 has a job that populates atlas runs programmatically and is documented in repo README.
Regression gate service responds to API call and returns PASS/WARN/BLOCK based on thresholds; synthetic regression tests exercise both WARN and BLOCK outcomes.
Runbook and dashboard links posted on Confluence; oncall knows escalation path for false positives.
Unit and integration tests cover ingest, rollups, and gate logic with >= 90% coverage for new modules.
notes: We will reuse the percentile-store ingester and add a small schema extension for route/model tags to avoid a full rewrite.
This ticket assumes existing SLO metadata storage for defaults; PM will provide overrides per-customer later.
Security and PII: no customer prompt text will be sent to telemetry—only latency numbers and non-sensitive tags (route identifier, model id, region).
